resources.string: Balanced changes nothing and restores your previous settings.
Picks a profile that fits the current state of your device and asks before changing anything.
Stopping apps frees memory but does not raise FPS. Results depend on the game and the device.
Needs Do Not Disturb access for FrameX
These apps will be asked to stop. They may restart later and unsaved data in them can be lost. System apps are never listed.
Your device is already hot, so no boost is applied. Let it cool down first.
Memory use is high, so freeing memory from apps you confirm may help.
Shizuku is connected, so game-mode tuning is available.
No special condition found; a light gaming profile is suggested.
Needs permission to change system settings
Method: real force-stop with shell access (Shizuku or wireless debugging), each app checked afterwards.
Method: real force-stop through the accessibility service, each app checked afterwards.
Method: background process kill. Android does not confirm per app; turn on Shizuku or the accessibility service in Settings for a real force-stop.
Stopped %1$d of %2$d apps. Available RAM changed by about %3$d MB.
This frees memory and background work. How much FPS it adds depends on the game and the device.
Stops every eligible background app right now. Apps on your never-stop list, system apps, the keyboard, launcher, dialer and SMS are always skipped.
Only a soft background kill is possible without Shizuku: Android does not allow a real force-stop of other apps to an ordinary app.
Data Saver (no background data from other apps)

Cuts the lag that comes from your own phone: Wi-Fi power saving, other apps using the connection in the background. It cannot make your internet line itself faster or shorten the way to the game server. It measures ping before and after, so you see what really changed. Needs shell access (Settings); without it only the low-latency Wi-Fi lock is used.
FrameX is in Local mode and makes no network connection. Change this in Settings → Network mode.
No active Wi-Fi or mobile connection to measure.
The active connection is not allowed by the network mode in Settings.
Average ping %1$s%% higher (no gain this time)
Could not compare: one of the runs had no replies.
A short test to a public server, not to your game server. Results vary from run to run, so repeat it a few times before trusting a small difference.
Stays on until you press \"Restore previous settings\" above.
Lower the whole screen resolution (looks softer; use before a game)
